recommendations.needs_product: This block needs a product — add it to a product page. To show a collection, best sellers or recently viewed products anywhere, use the Product Showcase block.

popular.empty: No products to show yet. Pick a collection with products in it, or clear the sold out filter.

collection.needs_collection: This store has no collections yet. Create one under Products → Collections, then choose it above.
collection.empty: That collection has no products to show. Pick another one above, or clear the sold out filter.

recently_viewed.empty: Products a shopper has viewed will appear here. Nothing shows in the theme editor because this preview has no browsing history — and it needs the app embed enabled under Theme settings → App embeds.

upsell.needs_product: Add this block to a product page — it bundles the product being viewed with its recommendations.

complementary.empty: No complementary products yet. Shopify only suggests these for products you have linked in the Search & Discovery app — open a product there, add its complementary products, and they will appear here. Nothing shows on your live storefront until then.

related.empty: Shopify has no recommendations for this product yet. It builds them from your order history, so a new product or a new store can come back empty.
